Reference / http/date

http/date#

HTTP dates (RFC 9110 §5.6.7): Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

HttpDate(SystemClock().instant()).string();        // for Date, Last-Modified
ParsedHttpDate("Sun, 06 Nov 1994 08:49:37 GMT").instant();

Description#

HTTP dates (RFC 9110 §5.6.7): Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT.

ParsedHttpDate reads the IMF-fixdate form and the two obsolete forms; the RFC 850 form has a two-digit year, so it needs a reference instant to pick the century (HttpDateReferenceRequired otherwise).

Public API#

object HttpDate#

object HttpDate does Comparing<HttpDate>

HTTP timestamps identify whole UTC seconds, including before Unix epoch. Calendar bounds are checked before narrowing an arbitrary rational duration.

object ParsedHttpDate#

object ParsedHttpDate

Parsing is deferred. An explicit reference is required only for the obsolete two-digit-year grammar, making century selection reproducible without a clock.
